# Fixture provenance

All JSON in this directory was authored for txflow-go on 2026-10-13.
Symbols are illustrative. Prices, increments, quantities, identifiers,
timestamps, account values, sequences and funding data are **synthetic**.
They are neither captured TxFlow responses nor verified contract specifications.
The JSON keys describe the proposed SDK domain schema.

These fixtures may test domain behavior and offline demos only. They must
never be used as signing vectors or evidence of exchange compatibility.
